questions.markdown: A metal-filament lamp, rated at $250\ \mathrm{W}$, $100\ \mathrm{V}$, is to be connected in series with a capacitor across a $230\ \mathrm{V}$, $50\ \mathrm{Hz}$ supply. Calculate: (a) the capacitance of the capacitor, and (b) the phase angle between the circuit current and the supply voltage.

A circuit having a resistance of $12\ \Omega$, an inductance of $0.15\ \mathrm{H}$ and a capacitance of $100\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ in series, is connected across a $100\ \mathrm{V}$, $50\ \mathrm{Hz}$ supply. Calculate: (a) the impedance, (b) the current, (c) the voltages across $R$, $L$ and $C$, and (d) the circuit power factor.

A 1-phase AC generator supplies the following loads:

i) Lighting load of $20\ \mathrm{kW}$ at unity power factor.

ii) Induction motor load of $100\ \mathrm{kW}$ at $0.707$ lagging power factor.

iii) Synchronous motor load of $50\ \mathrm{kW}$ at $0.9$ leading.

Calculate the total kW and kVA delivered by the generator and the power factor at which it works.

Three similar coils, each having a resistance of $8\ \Omega$ and an inductive reactance of $8\ \Omega$ are connected in star across a $415\ \mathrm{V}$, 3-phase, $50\ \mathrm{Hz}$ supply. Calculate active, reactive, and apparent power of the load and individual wattmeter readings if the power is measured by two-wattmeter method.

A star-connected balanced load is supplied from a 3-phase supply with a line voltage of $416\ \mathrm{V}$ at a frequency of $50\ \mathrm{Hz}$. Each phase of the load consists of a resistance and a capacitor connected in series, and the readings on two-wattmeters connected to measure the total power supplied are $782\ \mathrm{W}$ and $1980\ \mathrm{W}$. Calculate:

a) The power factor of the circuit

b) The line current.

c) The capacitance of each capacitor.
With a neat schematic discuss the working principle of a 1-phase digital energy meter.
Using circuit representation classify the different types of DC motors. Discuss their features.
